# EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation 2024/1689): scanner coverage map

<!-- generated by scripts/compliance-coverage.mjs from the framework file; do not edit by hand -->

This page lists every control the scanner evaluates for EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation 2024/1689), taken from `scanner/src/posture/compliance-frameworks/eu-ai-act.json`, the file the engine reads. It is regenerated from that file and checked for staleness, so it cannot disagree with what is assessed.

```bash
/compliance --walkthrough eu-ai-act
/compliance --report eu-ai-act
```

**7 controls** are evaluated: 5 with an automated mapping, 2 needing a person to attest. By how much a code scan can observe: 1 yes, 6 partial, 0 no.

**Scope.** SELECTIVE SUBSET. 7 obligations drawn from the high-risk-system and GPAI articles where a code signal exists. The Act is far broader; conformity assessment, registration, human oversight and post-market monitoring are organisational and are NOT represented here.

| Control | Requirement | Observable in code | Evaluated from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Art.9` | Risk management system — continuous, iterative risk identification and mitigation. | partial | `module:threat-model-auto`, `module:scan-history` |
| `Art.10` | Data governance — training/validation data is relevant, representative, and bias-checked. | yes | `family:training-data-pii`, `family:pii-exposure` |
| `Art.11` | Technical documentation — system architecture, components, training procedures documented. | partial | `module:aibom`, `module:threat-model-auto`, `module:compliance-policy` |
| `Art.12` | Record-keeping — automatic logging of system events for traceability. | partial | `module:scan-history` |
| `Art.13` | Transparency — instructions for use enable users to interpret the system's output correctly. | partial | a person attests |
| `Art.14` | Human oversight — system permits humans to override / interrupt. | partial | `module:apply-fix` |
| `Art.15` | Accuracy, robustness, cybersecurity — appropriate level of accuracy and resilience. | partial | a person attests |

## What this does not do

<!-- limits-verified: 2026-10-20 -->

- **It is a subset.** Only the controls above are evaluated. Everything else in the framework is outside what a code scan can observe and is not assessed here.
- **It is evidence, not an assessment.** A control reported as present means the mapped signals are clean on the last scan. It is not an attestation, a certification or a statement of compliance.
- **A control needing attestation is not evidenced.** Those controls are listed so the gap is visible, and they stay open until a person attests.
